model_choice_note: Document fixes encoder 32/64/128/256, GN8, LeakyReLU .01, decoder d=32/Cg=32/MLP64, eta=1e-3. User-approved 2026-11-06 for this box protocol (the document gives no values): relation MLP width Cr=64 (=C/4; its input is 2C+7=519), K=2 rounds (three fully connected nodes exchange directly in one round), deep writeback da=Cg=32 to match the decoder's d=32/Cg=32. 8,387,120 parameters. epsilon=1e-6 and gamma_init=0.1 keep the development values; GRU retains tested explicit reset-before-linear equations. Development choices, not tuned.
ablation_note: User-approved 2026-11-09 tier-1 ablation of train_brats_year_fold_bbox_amp_bf16.json: identical data, folds, crop, augmentation, bf16 mixed precision, optimizer, seed, epochs and early stopping; only the item below differs. Development comparison, not a frozen paper protocol. model.variant=drf_backbone: the dual-receptive-field encoder with a plain U-Net decoder (resize, concatenate the skip, two units, 1x1 head); no nodes, writeback, region queries or scale weights. The coarse 1x1 head on the deepest feature is kept as auxiliary deep supervision only, so the objective (lambda_c, lambda_hier) is identical to the full method. Node/relation fields are unused. 7,780,444 parameters.
protocol_note: Whole-brain-box year-specific patient folds, no stratification; full internal-dev every epoch. Cap 500 epochs, minimum 20, patience 20 epochs, accumulated Dice improvement >=0.001. Development choices, not an optimal/frozen paper protocol; official unlabeled validation not used for early stopping.
preprocessing_note: User-approved 2026-11-05: one whole-brain forward per case on the image-only box of nonzero voxels across T1/T1ce/T2/FLAIR, grown to a multiple of 8 inside the volume. Z-score statistics are unchanged (all nonzero voxels lie inside). Loading stops if any labeled tumor voxel would fall outside; the BraTS2018 training partition passed this audit (285/285). Not a patch or sliding window. Node c/s are relative to the box; BCE averages over box voxels.
loss_note: Hierarchy revision (层级一致性修订版.docx, eqs. 32-33): L = Lseg(final) + lambda_c*Lseg(coarse) + lambda_hier*Lhier(final). The document fixes lambda_hier >= 0 but gives no value; 1.0 is the development value the user agreed to on 2026-11-05; it is not tuned or stated in the paper.
precision_note: Comparison arm for whole-network mixed precision: encoder/decoder volumes, their 3x3x3 convolutions and pointwise projections run in bfloat16 with FP32 accumulation (each output rounded once). FP32: parameters and AdamW, GroupNorm statistics and normalization arithmetic, coarse head, Space-to-Node, relation rounds, deep writeback/fusion, scale weights, decoder score bias and gates, and the logits given to the loss. No loss scaling (bfloat16 keeps the FP32 exponent range). Requires --convolution-backend depth_sliced. Identical to train_brats_year_fold_bbox.json otherwise.
augmentation_note: User-approved 2026-11-06: light training-only augmentation, training cases only (dev/inference never). Each spatial axis mirrored with p=0.5 (image and label together); per modality, nonzero voxels scaled by U(0.9,1.1) and shifted by U(-0.1,0.1) z-score units, zero voxels stay zero. Draws are seeded by (seed, global step): exact on resume, no other RNG consumed, logged per step. No rotation/elastic/noise. Development choice.
